prompt: What is the purpose of `maybe_embed_entities` in `loomgraph.cli._common`? When does it actually call an embedding service, and when does it short-circuit?

ground_truth.notes:
Class C on a function (not class). Tests whether README_AI captures function-level intent or only class-level. maybe_embed_entities short-circuits when settings.embedding.enabled is False (the v0.11.0 default); otherwise it calls Jina/Ollama/OpenAI-compatible embedding service and attaches embeddings for vec0 KNN search.

Must mention: 'embedding.enabled' (the gate) and 'vec0' (the destination). Substring match case-insensitive. 2/2 → 1.0; 1 → 0.5; 0 → 0.0.

Function docstring describes both conditions in the body. README_AI for cli/_common may capture this in less detail than class C-1/C-2 because READMEs typically have less detail per function than per class.

rationale: Class C third descriptive task — function-level (vs class-level for C-1/C-2). Tests whether README_AI's function description detail is enough or whether Path B's tool-fetched description wins. Different shape from C-1 (storage class) and C-2 (analyzer class).
